description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: A modern file manager that helps users organize their files and folders.
Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.
Your platform team, as a service
AI conversations that actually remember. Never re-explain your project to your AI again. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/tyvKNccgqN
AI-powered GitHub stars manager with semantic search, auto-categorization, and release tracking
Get tasks and ideas out of your head. A free GTD to-do app for desktop and mobile. Works offline, no account needed
The next-generation Markdown editor, with an AI writing assistant. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.
Fast, free voice assistant for your Mac. No API key: runs on your Claude Pro or Max plan. Sends background agents for big jobs, remembers you and learns your shortcuts. Hold ⌃⌥Space and talk.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
Free, open-source Mac utility: start dragging any file, tap a key, and drop it on a wheel to convert, edit, AirDrop or shelve it. Runs fully offline.

Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.
Turn repeated Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor prompts into reusable slash commands. Local Python history extractor + Agent Skill.
One AI agent, everywhere you work — terminal, desktop, mobile, and your chat apps. Rust core.

Oyenza Studio (formerly Oyen Poni): a living notch (Dynamic Island) for Windows and Mac. Music with synced lyrics, a focus timer, a file shelf your phone can drop into, tasks, clipboard history and live system stats. Native Rust, free and open source.

Aetox: a local-first Windows AI environment - model, skills, team and memory as one system. Two doors - an Assistant that adapts to your work and drives a real browser; and a Developer that names each weakness before writing, checks the project's security, runs the project's tests before saying done, and remembers what this project decided.
